How is the Las Vegas real estate market in 2026?

The Las Vegas market in 2026 shows strong fundamentals with median home prices at $485K, averaging 28 days on market. West Summerlin continues to lead in luxury property appreciation.

What areas do you specialize in?

I specialize in West Summerlin, including zip codes 89138, 89144, and 89135. These areas feature luxury communities like The Ridges, Red Rock Country Club, and Summerlin West.

How can I get my home's current market value?

Use my free home value calculator for an instant estimate based on current market data, or contact me for a comprehensive Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) tailored to your property.

Yes! I guide first-time buyers through the entire process, from financing pre-approval to closing. I make complex transactions simple and stress-free.
